title.rendered: Board of Directors Special Work Session – January 4, 2023

content.rendered:
The Sherwood School District Board of Directors will meet in a special work session on Wednesday, January 4, 2023, starting at 6:00pm at the District Office Board Room (21920 SW Sherwood Blvd). The agenda for this meeting can be viewed here. The next regular meeting of the Board will be held on Wednesday, January 18, 2023.

All meetings of the Board of Directors can also be viewed live at the District’s YouTube channel at https://bit.ly/39VlhD3.
